name: Unplug
summary: Disconnect an app: the plug pops out of its socket, the cable goes slack and an undo bar counts down
about: Unplug makes removing an integration feel physical. Each connected app is wired to your shop with a swaying cable and little data pulses running along it. Disconnect pulls the cable tight, wiggles the plug and pops it out with sparks, so it swings and dangles on a slack, springy cable while the app greys out and the steps tick off. A countdown bar with a fizzing tip gives eight seconds to undo, which flies the plug back in with a zap; after that, Reconnect plugs it in again.
how: Pick an app at the top to see its connection on the bench.
Press Disconnect: the plug pops out, the steps tick and an 8-second undo bar starts.
Press Undo (or Ctrl+Z) before it runs out to plug it straight back in.
Once the bar runs out, press Reconnect to connect the app again.
